Verified “Our seed round raised $2 million.” Example evidence: An investor announcement reports the same company, seed round, and USD amount. Reason: Comparable evidence supports this specific claim. Information Readiness measures how complete and reviewable the available information is; it is not an assessment of whether an investment should be made. Generated Oct 27, 2026. What Zelda analyzed The work behind this report — counted, not estimated. 12 Pages analyzed 12 Sections searched 2 Categories analyzed Business Model & Growth Analysis Insufficient disclosed data to describe the business model. No revenue model, pricing structure, customer type, or growth mechanism was extracted from the document. The only indicators of commercial activity are the company's self-reported traction figures — 140 000+ bots [S1] and 500M messages with no explicit interval [S2] on page 10, under 'Traction by Apr-16', and separately 500M messages/month [S3] on page 12 (see consistency note below) — but these figures are undated as counts and have not been independently verified [C2, C3, C4]. How the company monetises these users, what drives bot creation, and what the expansion strategy is are not found in the extracted evidence. Information Readiness Score: 10/100 Present: • Self-reported funding total from Pitch Deck Hunt: $23.1M [S4] • Self-reported traction metrics: 140,000+ bots and 500M messages, contextualised to a slide headed 'Traction by Apr-16' [S1, S2] • Self-reported usage rate on a separate slide: 500M messages/month [S3] • Profile-level stage (Series A) and sector (Software) [P1, P2] Needs Validation: • Funding amount and round history (checked but unconfirmed) [C1] • Bot count and message volume metrics (checked but unconfirmed) [C2, C3, C4] • Clarification of whether 500M messages is a cumulative total or a monthly rate [C2, C3] • Revenue, burn, gross margin, and unit economics • Team identities and credentials • Product description and feature set • Market size and competitive landscape • Business model and pricing • Problem statement and target customer • Use of proceeds Next evidence to supply: Audited or accountant-reviewed financials showing revenue, gross margin, and monthly burn rate, together with a clear definition of how the 500M messages figure is measured (cumulative vs. monthly). Supported Points Pitch Deck Hunt lists $23.1M raised [S4], indicating the company has attracted external capital, though the figure is undated and unverified [C1]. The company states 140,000+ bots and 500M messages under a slide headed 'Traction by Apr-16' [S1, S2], suggesting meaningful platform activity at that point, subject to the caveat that neither figure has been independently confirmed [C3, C4]. Open Concerns The 500M messages figure appears twice with different measurement bases — as an undated total on page 10 and as a monthly rate on page 12 [C2, C3] — and the two cannot be compared or confirmed as equivalent without clarification; this ambiguity goes to the reliability of the company's own traction reporting. No revenue, burn, or use-of-proceeds information was extracted, leaving the economic viability of the business entirely uncharacterised.
